strengths: Proper safe area handling with .safeAreaInset() for consistent UI across device sizes
Correct usage of @Environment(.dismiss) to manage back button dismissal without navigation bar duplication
Use of @StateObject for view model that is retained across view transitions and avoids memory leaks
weaknesses: Risk of double navigation bars when the screen is added to a navigation stack that already contains a navigation view
@Environment(.dismiss) might fail if the dismiss action is not properly connected to the parent view's navigation stack
Inconsistent handling of safe area insets in nested views leading to UI clipping or overflow on certain device orientations
verdict: Moderate risk: Plan addresses safe area and dismiss handling but risks double navigation bars and state management.
